text: The library will close at 4 p.m. on Friday while electricians replace the lights. Holds that expire on Friday can be collected on Saturday.
reason: A public notice gives the change, reason, and practical consequence directly.

text: Toast the cumin in a dry pan until it smells nutty, about thirty seconds. Tip it into a bowl before adding the oil to the pan.
reason: Sensory language gives a useful cooking cue and the instructions remain concrete.

text: Hi Mara, I found the missing invoices in the archive folder. Two are unsigned; I marked those in the spreadsheet so you can check them before Friday.
reason: The greeting belongs to the email genre, and the rest reports specific work.

text: This cup was repaired with three metal staples. The holes beside the crack show where the restorer drilled through the clay.
reason: Passive voice and an inference tied to visible evidence are appropriate to an object label.

text: I liked the first half of the novel more than the ending. Once the narrator left the farm, I missed the arguments with her sister.
reason: A subjective opinion is grounded in the reviewer’s stated experience rather than inflated into universal judgment.

text: Version 4 rejects files with duplicate column names. Earlier versions kept the final occurrence and discarded the others without a warning.
reason: The version comparison describes a concrete behavior change.

text: We excluded four trials because the camera stopped before the final measurement. The remaining 36 trials included observations from all six animals.
reason: The methods passage identifies a specific exclusion rule and the resulting sample.

text: The argument requires a finite graph. On an infinite graph, the sequence of distinct vertices need not contain a cycle.
reason: The restriction and countercase serve the mathematical explanation.

text: Median response time fell from 18 ms to 13 ms after the index was added. The benchmark used the same 40 queries and a warm cache in both runs.
reason: The result supplies a comparison and enough context to interpret its scope.

text: The brochure describes the scanner as "a game-changing leap into tomorrow." Replace that claim with its scan resolution and supported paper sizes.
reason: The promotional phrase is quoted as an object of criticism, not used as the author’s own claim.

text: Together, we can weave a brighter tapestry of hope, empowering communities and fostering transformative change as we embark on this extraordinary journey toward a better tomorrow.
reason: A fundraising appeal consists of grand abstractions and stock metaphors without identifying an action or beneficiary.

text: Nestled in the heart of an enchanting region, our village boasts a rich tapestry of experiences, seamlessly blending timeless charm with vibrant modern energy. There truly is something for everyone.
reason: The travel description stacks generic promotional phrases instead of describing the place.

text: This update marks a monumental turning point in the history of spreadsheets. By changing the toolbar color, it redefines what is possible and paves the way for a bold new era of productivity.
reason: The claimed historical importance is disproportionate to the stated cosmetic change.

text: Our café is not about coffee. It is about connection. Not about sandwiches, but about stories. Not about lunch, but about limitless possibility.
reason: Repeated negative parallelism replaces information with vague promotional abstractions.

text: Leading voices have praised the mayor’s announcement as visionary. Observers across the field agree that its far-reaching impact will be felt for decades, according to numerous reports.
reason: Unattributed voices and reports are used to support sweeping praise and predictions.

text: Certainly! I would be delighted to craft clear instructions for you. Here is the revised section in a professional tone: press the green switch. I hope this helps, and feel free to ask for another version!
reason: Assistant conversation surrounds the actual manual instruction.

text: The workshop ended at noon. Ultimately, as we look ahead to the future, only time will tell what lies on the horizon, but one thing is certain: the journey has only just begun.
reason: The ending supplies generic forecasts and clichés unrelated to the reported event.

text: The exhibition features [NUMBER] paintings by [ARTIST NAME]. Insert an evocative description of the gallery here, then add a memorable closing line that leaves the reader inspired.
reason: Template fields and writing instructions remain in supposed publication prose.

text: Our astonishingly elegant framework constitutes a profoundly significant contribution, delivering unprecedented excellence and establishing an entirely new paradigm of scholarly rigor.
reason: Unsubstantiated evaluative superlatives replace a description of the research contribution.

text: The undertaking of the implementation of the revision was performed for the purpose of the achievement of an improvement in the facilitation of access to the records.
reason: Stacked nominalizations and circumlocutions conceal the action and its intended result.
